_meta.title: Irregularity register: arena-9abdf3f7 audit of main @ 2f44c98
_meta.severity_scale: High = could mislead a reader or run unreviewed code; Medium = data or label is wrong or stale; Low = precision or wording; Info = limitation of this audit
_meta.rule: Logged, not silently corrected. Fixes belong to the integration session or the owning session.

items.finding: refresh-data.yml runs at 11:15, 15:15 and 22:15 UTC with permissions contents: write and pushes the checked-out branch with git push. The fetch, rebuild and page-build steps are continue-on-error. No run has ever executed (gh run list returns none).
items.evidence: Workflow file; gh run list --workflow refresh-data.yml returned []
items.suggested_action: Disable the schedule, or make the job open a pull request instead of pushing to main, before first use.
items.status_note: Checked on main 5fd46c8: cron, contents: write and git push all present; gh run list shows no runs.

items.finding: data/teams_advanced_2026_27.json says 'Per Mode: Per Game', but MIN is a season total (48 x GP plus 5 per overtime game, e.g. LAL 624.0 = 13 x 48) and POSS is documented as a season total. The numbers match the official page; the label does not match them.
items.evidence: Stored MIN minus 48 x GP is 0 or a multiple of 5 for all 30 teams. The official page URL carries no PerMode parameter and its text does not show the selected mode.
items.suggested_action: Confirm the Per Mode on the live page and correct the label to 'Totals' if confirmed. Values are not changed.
items.status_note: Checked on main 5fd46c8: label still reads 'Per Mode: Per Game'.

items.finding: docs/pages/summary.html states 682 table rows. The generator now produces 693. scripts/verify_all.py rewrites this tracked file on every run, exits 0, and leaves git status dirty.
items.evidence: Run of scripts/verify_all.py on 2f44c98: git diff changed one line, '682' to '693'.
items.suggested_action: Integration session regenerates and commits the page (task V03 on arena/a6936331-nba1). Verification should check, not write, tracked files.
items.status_note: Checked on main 5fd46c8 (PR #19): summary.html now reads 693, equal to the generator output. verify_all.py was run in a clean checkout and left the tree unchanged.

items.finding: COORDINATION.md on main still lists U14 as 'in progress' and U12 as 'needs review', still names base f73edd2, and has no entries for open PR #11 (arena/c7fbc064-nba1), open PR #14 (arena/7cfd203a-nba1), or the remote branches arena/a6936331-nba1 and arena/d3892d13-nba1.
items.evidence: gh pr list --state open; git ls-remote --heads origin.
items.suggested_action: Integration session reconciles the board and decides the fate of PRs #11 and #14.
items.status_note: PR #19 corrected U14 and logged PRs #11 and #14 as open (F-C10). Still open: arena/a6936331-nba1 (PR #21 open) and arena/d3892d13-nba1 are not on main's board, and U14 still shows 'in progress' in §2.

items.finding: pages.yml uploads path '.', so the whole repository is published, including COORDINATION.md, notes/, scripts/ and the raw snapshots. The build-A link check is continue-on-error, so a broken link in build A does not stop the deploy.
items.evidence: Workflow file, 'path: .' and 'continue-on-error: true' on the build-A validation step.
items.suggested_action: Publish a dedicated site directory, and make the link check blocking.
items.status_note: Checked on main 5fd46c8: path: '.' and continue-on-error both present.

items.finding: Two independent dashboards are published (build A at the root and in docs/, build B at docs/b/). Neither links to the other, and the cross-link request (R1) has not been executed.
items.evidence: Root index.html and docs/b/index.html are both live.
items.suggested_action: Integration session adds the cross-link (R1 / V04) and then decides on one landing page.
items.status_note: Checked on main 5fd46c8: root index.html links to docs/b/index.html (R1 closed by PR #19). Two dashboards are still published.

items.finding: games_completed.json records overtime as a yes/no flag. DET at WAS on 2026-11-12 is 'Final/OT2' on the official page (two overtimes); the stored row records OT only.
items.evidence: Official card label 'Final/OT2'; stored ot = true.
items.suggested_action: Add an overtime-count column when the table is next rebuilt. Score values are not affected.
items.status_note: Stored data unchanged; OT still recorded as a flag.

items.finding: The official Teams > Advanced page does not display a capture time. The season-to-date window is confirmed only by matching games-played totals to the stored window (through 11/12).
items.evidence: Official page text; games-played values equal the stored values for all 30 teams.
items.suggested_action: Record the exact capture time and URL with every snapshot (already done for the team table in data/raw; not done on the official page itself).
items.status_note: Official page still shows no capture time.

items.finding: The README's GitHub Pages section calls PR #4 'the current integration'. That is out of date: the integration is now PRs #15 to #18. The Actions run it cites (43520295487) does exist and succeeded.
items.evidence: gh pr view 4 (MERGED, arena/4f997533-nba1); gh run view 43520295487 (success).
items.suggested_action: Reword the section with the current PR list.
items.status_note: Checked on main 5fd46c8: README line 66 unchanged.

items.finding: Branch protection on main could not be read with this session's credentials (HTTP 403). Whether direct pushes (I-01) are blocked is therefore unknown.
items.suggested_action: A maintainer with admin rights should check the setting in the repository settings.
items.status_note: Still HTTP 403 with this session's token.
